🚀 Excited to announce the release of **llm-sanitizer**!

`llm-sanitizer` is an open-source Python package that helps developers and organizations automatically detect and redact sensitive information from LLM (Large Language Model) prompts, completions, and logs. It supports customizable redaction rules, integrates easily with existing LLM pipelines, and helps ensure privacy and compliance in AI workflows.

✨ Now available as:
- A Python package (install via PyPI: `pip install llm-sanitizer`)
- A command-line tool (CLI)
- A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for easy integration with LLM gateways and orchestration tools

We’d love your feedback! If you’re working with LLMs or handling sensitive data, please check out the project, try it in your stack, and let us know what works, what doesn’t, and what features you’d like to see next.

🚨 New open-source release: **llm-sanitizer**

LLM security is lagging behind adoption. Prompt injection, hidden instructions in documents, and embedded agent directives are now real attack vectors—not just theory.

To help address this, I’ve built **llm-sanitizer**:

🔗 https://github.com/Warnes-Innovations/llm-sanitizer  
🔗 https://pypi.org/project/llm-sanitizer/

**What is it?**
- Detects and classifies embedded LLM instructions in documents, code, and web content
- Redacts or neutralizes those instructions before they reach your model
- Runs as a Python package, CLI tool, or MCP-compatible server
- Available on PyPI

Think of it as a **pre-processing security layer**—intercepting prompts before they ever hit your LLM. It targets embedded instruction payloads and prompt injection vectors across artifact types, not just raw text.

**Why?**
Most LLM apps trust upstream content—a risky assumption. If you ingest scraped web pages, PDFs, code, or user uploads, you already have a prompt injection surface.

**Feedback wanted!**
This is an early release (v0.1.0) and I’m actively iterating. I’d love your input on:
- Detection strategies (regex, structural, model-assisted)
- False positive/negative tradeoffs
